Two kids, works night shifts, checks Facebook on breaks. Clicks warm human-interest and health stories that feel share-worthy to her mom friends; scrolls past politics and anything that reads like a lecture. Trusts specific, concrete claims over hype; deep curiosity-gap teasers work if the topic feels relevant to family life.

Shares content that signals identity and values; ironic detachment about obvious bait but will click a genuinely surprising twist.

Reads for inspiration and human interest; literal reader who likes clear, plain-language headlines and distrusts slangy or cryptic ones. Moderate politically, avoids outrage. Motivated by uplift, animals, kids, and 'faith in humanity restored' framings; wordy or academic headlines lose her.

Skeptical, reads Reddit and Hacker News, sniffs out clickbait instantly and feels contempt for it. Rewards precise, information-dense headlines with real stakes; punishes vague curiosity gaps by refusing to click on principle. Will engage sharp contrarian or counterintuitive claims if they sound credible.

Busy, practical, Muslim-American, shares community and good-news stories on Facebook. Values dignity and respect in framing; put off by edgy, mocking, or sensational tones. Clicks stories about ordinary people doing extraordinary things; concrete specifics beat teasers.

Short attention, scrolls fast, drawn to surprise, humor, and 'you won't believe' novelty. Bored by worthy or dry civic headlines. Emotional hooks (shock, awe, laughter) and pop-culture references drive the tap; long or formal headlines get skipped.

Center-right, reads on lunch break, cares about family, safety, faith, and personal responsibility. Clicks moral and heartwarming stories; distrusts headlines that feel politically preachy from the left. Prefers a clear promise of payoff over a mysterious tease.

Bilingual, progressive, education- and equity-minded. Shares stories about teaching, immigration, and social change with clear moral stakes. Values substance and accuracy; rewards headlines that signal a real story over manipulative gaps; irony and specificity land.

Highly online, values-driven, activist-adjacent. Moved by injustice-and-uplift arcs and identity-affirming stories she can share to signal her values. Curiosity gaps work when the cause feels urgent; cynical, edgy, or apolitical-fluff headlines fall flat.

Working-class, union background, reads on an iPad his daughter set up. Plain-spoken, likes clear headlines about jobs, veterans, fairness, and nostalgia. Distrusts fancy or cryptic wording and anything that smells like an ad; concrete beats clever.

Analytical, immigrant, curious about science, health, and 'how things work.' Rewards headlines with a clear knowledge payoff and credible specifics; rolls her eyes at obvious bait that under-delivers. Will click a good mystery or counterintuitive finding.

Image-conscious, motivated by what makes him look good sharing to friends; loves uplifting, surprising, or aspirational stories. Skims headlines in seconds; emotional and identity hooks win, dense or dry framings lose. Shares 'wow' content.

Casual daily scroller, drawn to human interest, health scares, relationships, and animals. Emotional and warm framings land; cynical or ironic tones put her off. Prefers headlines that tell her what she'll get; curiosity gaps work only if the topic feels personal.

Pressed for time, checks phone between shifts. Clicks sports, money, and 'useful to know' stories with clear stakes; skips vague or worthy-sounding headlines. Rewards a concrete promise; distrusts over-the-top sensationalism.

Aesthetically-driven, ironic, follows indie and activist accounts. Rewards clever wordplay, authenticity, and cultural nuance; punishes corporate or earnest-but-generic voice. Shares content that signals taste and values; obvious bait is a turn-off.

Moderate, pragmatic, reads for a quick break. Clicks heartwarming, surprising, or practically-useful stories; avoids partisan outrage. Wants the headline to signal a clear, worthwhile payoff; wordy or cryptic headlines get skipped.

Time-poor, evidence-minded, skeptical of medical hype and sensationalism. Rewards accurate, specific, substantive framings; distrusts fear-mongering health bait. Will click a genuinely surprising, credible human story shared in her network.

Low patience for pretension, scrolls fast, drawn to shock, humor, sports, and outrage-at-unfairness. Concrete and punchy wins; academic or wordy headlines lose instantly. Shares content that vents a shared frustration or delivers a laugh.

Faith-centered, warm, shares uplifting and moral stories widely. Clicks 'restore your faith in humanity,' kids, and kindness framings; put off by crude, cynical, or mocking tones. Prefers clear, sincere headlines over clever teases.

Progressive, intellectually curious, reads long-form and follows academics. Rewards substantive, nuanced, counterintuitive framings; contempt for clickbait curiosity gaps. Shares to inform, not to emote; specificity and credibility drive the click.

Chatty, social, shares relatable and dramatic human-interest stories with clients and friends. Drawn to relationships, transformations, and 'you have to see this' surprise. Emotional hooks win; dry, formal, or political headlines get scrolled past.

Working-class, reads on his phone during layovers. Clicks stories about fairness, community, sports, and local pride; skips worthy-but-boring or preachy framings. Rewards a clear, concrete promise; distrusts obvious manipulation.

Digital-native, trend-aware, professionally fluent in headlines so she notices the technique. Rewards genuinely clever or fresh angles; jaded about tired formulas and templated bait. Shares aspirational or clever content that fits her feed's vibe.

Conservative, patriotic, reads for human interest and inspiration. Clicks stories about service, faith, animals, and everyday heroism; distrusts slangy, ironic, or left-preachy headlines. Plain, sincere, concrete framings beat clever or cryptic ones.
